TITLE: UNO · Party
LOBBY_HINT:
Scan or find this game on the LAN
Start with 2–6 players
DEBT: Penalty: +%d · stack a penalty card or draw them all
RULES_BODY: TV is a public display by default; 2–6 phone players receive 7 cards each. Phone hosts may turn Public screen off to play. Match colour or symbol. Skip misses the next player; Reverse changes direction (acts as Skip with two players). +2 accepts +2 or +4; +4 accepts only +4, regardless of colour. Draw the whole accumulated penalty and lose your turn. Wild and +4 choose a colour; +4 is unrestricted, with no challenge. Drawing voluntarily is allowed, then only the new card can be played. Say UNO when leaving one card; opponents can catch a missed call for +2 before the next play/draw/pass. The first discard is a number card. First empty hand wins; a final penalty is drawn before scoring. Everyone must agree to play again.
